# Diffusion Model Pipeline / LoRA Switch Config

This workflow routes between three model paths (FL2VA T2V/I2V, REF2VA, and H3 Fast Video), each with its own LoRA and sampling settings, feeding into a single **Model Switch** node for selection at runtime.

## Model #1 - FL2VA (T2V/I2V)

- **Base model**: `minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8...`
- **LoRA**: `minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_4step_v1.0_768p_comfyui_bf...` (strength: 1.00)
- **Sampling shift**: Video 6.00 / Audio 3.00

## Model #2 - REF2VA

- **Base model**: `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int...`
- **LoRA**: `minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.sa...` (strength: 1.00)
- **Sampling shift**: Video 12.00 / Audio 3.00

## Model #3 - H3 Fast Video

- **Base model**: `minimax_h3_fastvideo_vsa_dat...`
- **LoRA**: bypassed by default (this model is already a speed-optimized diffusion model, so no turbo LoRA is needed)
- **Optional**: users can un-bypass the LoRA node to stack the FL2VA turbo LoRA on top of the fast video model. This may speed things up further but will likely introduce quality deficits.
- **Sampling shift**: Video 12.00 / Audio 3.00

## Model Switch

- **Node**: Impact-Pack Model Switch
- **Inputs**: up to 5 model inputs (input1–input5), only inputs 1–3 populated here
- **select**: 1 (currently routing Model #1)
- **sel_mode**: `select_on_execution`

## Notes

- Each path uses `ModelSamplingMiniMax` to set video/audio shift values before hitting the switch.
- Feeds into KSamplerSelect (sampler: `er_sde`) and BasicScheduler (scheduler: `simple`) downstream.
- ## IMPORTANT: IF you are switching between models using the switch node, make sure you change the MODEL TYPE in the DIRECTOR node configuration.

extra.description: SFW ref2va (Reference to Video) example: one continuous golden-hour forest run, 3 segments x 7s (21s total @24fps). Subject 1 is an athletic elf woman sprinting through dense forest, clearing a creek and a log, vaulting onto a high branch, then stopping at a cliff edge to view the vast forest. Dynamic cinematic camera (orbit / tracking / low-angle pan). No dialogue, no music - only exertion breaths, movement grunts, clothes rustle, footfalls, forest ambience. To use: upload a headshot as Picture 1 and a full-body character sheet as Picture 2 in the Director's common references, then generate (Export all). Requires the H3 REF2VA model selected on the ImpactSwitch (select 2 = MODEL_2 / ref2va path).
